caption: A party light is switched from white to green, and the white walls of the room turn green.

sa.check: A party light lights a room with white walls.
It is switched from white to green.
Things in the light's shadow stay unchanged.
The switch comes first and the colour changes with it.

pc.expect: The wall looks green only where the light's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The wall is green with the light off; or stays white under the green light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the light and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The wall changes before the light; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: Objects in the light's shadow keep their own colour.
pc.fail: Shadowed objects turn green too; or lit objects stay white; or the shadows vanish.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The wall moves; or the light moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second light appears; or the wall vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The wall's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The wall changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the light changes shape.
